validation_period.policy: the exact specification is evaluated once without H2 sweep, threshold change, scope change, processing-order change, gate change or combination

processing_order: structural exits for still-open F05 positions
candidate_rule.marked_mfe_definition: maximum executable marked P/L at M15 bar-open boundaries after entry and strictly before current decision; long uses Bid and short uses Ask with fixed five-point spread
candidate_rule.breakout_level_definition: entry-specific F05 breakout level stored from the accepted signal: current_high for long, current_low for short
candidate_rule.invalidation_condition: latest completed M15 close is at least 1.0 pip inside the breakout level against position direction
candidate_rule.exit_price: Bid for long; Ask for short

base_contract.hard_excluded_entry_window: unchanged DST-aware accepted Asia-preopen / New-York-rollover rule
base_contract.execution_engine: Rakuten MT4 Strategy Tester on interactive self-hosted Windows runner

accepted_reusable_h2_baseline_contract.provenance: accepted same-run Rakuten MT4 2024 H2 baseline contract previously reproduced in formal USDJPY validations; candidate-specific F05_MFE20 H2 outcome not accessed

outcome_comparison_contract.entry_key_relation: candidate opened keys must exactly equal baseline opened keys
outcome_comparison_contract.complete_outcome_definition: each opened key is represented by its closed P/L, or by period_end_open_position floating P/L when still open at 2024 H2 end
outcome_comparison_contract.complete_outcome_net: sum of closed P/L and period-end marked P/L across all 494 opened keys
outcome_comparison_contract.complete_outcome_pf: profit factor across the same 494 complete outcomes
outcome_comparison_contract.changed_outcome_definition: only F05 keys carrying the frozen candidate structural_exit audit detail may differ in outcome kind, outcome time or P/L
outcome_comparison_contract.unaffected_outcome_rule: every non-structural key must retain identical outcome kind, time and P/L
outcome_comparison_contract.monthly_and_quarter_definition: closed-trade P/L grouped by close month; Q3 is July-September and Q4 is October-December
outcome_comparison_contract.entry_date_concentration_definition: complete-outcome candidate-minus-baseline effect aggregated by entry UTC date

frozen_evidence.ex4_hash_note: generated MQ4 bytes are binding; EX4 is recorded but not used as the identity gate because equivalent successful MetaEditor compiles can produce different EX4 bytes

fixed_h2_gates.decision_rule: PASS only if every binding gate implemented by the frozen evaluator passes; otherwise the exact specification closes as FAIL
required: accepted reusable H2 baseline contract is reproduced exactly
candidate entry set exactly equals baseline entry set with zero missing or extra entries
exactly one candidate_contract row is present
all changed outcomes exactly reconcile to F05 structural_exit rows carrying the frozen candidate ID
every unaffected outcome kind, time and P/L remains unchanged
B02 entry keys, outcome kinds, outcome times, counts and P/L remain exactly unchanged
candidate closed-trade net JPY is positive and exceeds same-run baseline closed net
candidate complete-outcome marked net JPY is positive and exceeds same-run baseline marked net
candidate closed-trade PF is at least same-run baseline closed PF
candidate complete-outcome PF is at least same-run baseline complete-outcome PF
candidate direct tick-equity DD is not worse than same-run baseline
candidate minimum tick equity is not below same-run baseline
candidate final equity exceeds same-run baseline
candidate Q3 and Q4 closed-trade net JPY are both positive
Q3 and Q4 closed-trade deltas are both nonnegative
at least three close-month effects are positive and at most one is negative
F05 complete-outcome net delta is positive
complete-outcome net delta remains positive after removing the two strongest positive entry-date effects
largest positive entry-date effect is at most 50 percent of total benefit
total benefit exceeds total harm
zero order-send and order-close failures

gate_provenance.H1_candidate_specific_values: Research freeze v2 and accepted exact Rakuten MT4 parity evidence only
gate_provenance.H2_baseline_values: accepted reusable 2024 H2 Rakuten MT4 baseline contract

post_h2_rule.H2_PASS: freeze the unchanged H2 identities and result, preregister all 2025 H1 gates, then execute the unchanged candidate with Rakuten MT4 Strategy Tester on accepted 2025 H1 history
post_h2_rule.H2_FAIL: close F05_MFE20_BOR1_EXIT_v1 without H2 repair, retuning, gate change or 2025 H1 execution

closure_rule: failure of any fixed H2 gate closes this exact 20-pip prior marked MFE / 1-pip breakout-origin re-entry / one completed close F05-only structural Exit specification; any successor returns to 2024 H1 under a new candidate ID
